tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification in development builds

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays on in every build, development builds included, so there is no exception that lets a development build skip it. An earlier note allowing development builds to skip verification was withdrawn and no longer applies. The project has also recorded that HTTPS is used everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
